description: Day-by-day downloads, oldest first, for a whole podcast or, with episode, for one episode. Days with no downloads appear with zeros, and each day is a calendar day in the podcast’s time zone. downloads is Fireside’s count, spotify is reported by Spotify, and total is their sum. One call covers up to a year; for a longer period, call once for each part.

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today in the podcast’s time zone.

episode.description: Episode token (UUID) or slug, as shown by fireside_list_episodes. Leave out for the whole podcast.

podcast.description: Podcast token (UUID) or slug, as shown by fireside_list_podcasts. Required unless FIRESIDE_PODCAST is configured.

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 29 days before end_date.

name: fireside_get_daily_downloads
title: Get daily downloads
